bird_cold_restart.scope:
Six disk-backed Chromium restarts for postal pigeons and consignment gabians.
Seed-only fixtures prepare native saves. Resume loads byte-identical production HTML
at the same file URL, clicks Continue, and has no seed bridge or fake storage.
Scripted positions and authored interiors only; no power-cut or real IGN certification.

rat_cold_restart.scope: Native disk-backed Chromium LocalStorage at an offline file URL and full process restart followed by native Continue on unchanged production HTML. Fixture-only seed constructs the authored depot and prepares its checkpoint through runtime helpers; it does not verify port travel. Observer pauses immediately after Continue for exact comparison. No real IGN exterior return, power-loss or human campaign certification.

features: Persistent visible key, ring and whistle reconstructed from existing handoffs
Completed objective leads to exit; optional handoffs marked as optional
limits: Procedural stylized received-object gestures, not a continuous transfer from the player hand or counter.
Scripted camera/positions and synthetic origins in browser suites, not a human playthrough or full IGN traversal.
Cold suites cover prepared disk-backed Chromium restarts, not power loss or every browser.
No voice acting, owner departure routines, ferry or autonomous postal network.
Parallel PR17 COCHONNET is not incorporated.
counting_note: Local repetitions are not additional distinct tests. QA_LOCAL is a historical local preview report.
publication_note: This report records completed validation on the working tree before its source publication commit. It does not assert a main merge or deployment.
